categories.main_business_segments: The company is a professional manufacturer specializing in thermistors and temperature sensors, oxygen sensors, and pressure sensors. It operates through three main product lines: thermistor and temperature sensor products (including PTC and NTC thermistors), pressure sensors (ceramic capacitive, MEMS, and glass micro-fusion types), and oxygen sensors (including NOx sensors). The company serves as a first-batch national-level specialized and sophisticated 'little giant' enterprise.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses a complete vertical industry chain from ceramic material research and development to thermistor and sensor manufacturing. Core technologies include ceramic material formulation, powder preparation, slurry preparation, ceramic substrate preparation, forming, sintering, printing, packaging, and MEMS chip design. The company has accumulated deep expertise in ceramic material characteristics and has established core process technology platforms covering material formulation, ceramic substrate preparation, forming, sintering, printing, and packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major domestic appliance manufacturers (Midea, Gree, Aux, Haier, TCL, Hisense), international appliance brands (Nestlé Nespresso, Keurig Dr Pepper, Toshiba, Panasonic, Electrolux, Samsung), automotive OEMs (BYD, SAIC, Great Wall, Dongfeng, Chery, Geely, Chang'an), automotive Tier-1 suppliers (Valeo, Magna, Gentherm, Tuopu, Sanhua, Wanliyang, Bosch, Leiyun), and companies in photovoltaic and energy storage sectors (Huawei, BYD).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing and R&D bases in Shenzhen, Dongguan, and Chenzhou (Hunan). It has established three major research and manufacturing bases and maintains sales operations across domestic markets. The company also conducts export business, with foreign sales accounting for approximately 14.29% of total revenue in 2023, serving customers in North America and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures and supplies critical electronic components (thermistors and sensors) to downstream manufacturers including appliance makers, automotive OEMs, and Tier-1 automotive suppliers. The company sources raw materials and components from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products to customers for integration into their products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology innovation as its core driver, with strategic focus on developing intelligent sensor core technologies and maintaining technological leadership. R&D initiatives include MEMS pressure sensor development, glass micro-fusion pressure sensor technology, ceramic capacitive pressure sensors, temperature sensors for new energy vehicles, oxygen sensors meeting National Six emission standards, and integration of temperature and pressure sensing. The company invested 47.4 million yuan in R&D in 2023, representing 6.35% of total revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured thermistors and sensors to downstream manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products, typically upon delivery and customer confirmation. The company employs a make-to-order production model based on customer orders. Secondary revenue comes from testing services. The company uses both direct sales channels and indirect sales through automotive Tier-1 suppliers and logistics partners.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both domestic and international sensor manufacturers. It has established itself as a leading domestic automotive-grade pressure sensor manufacturer and is advancing import substitution in high-end sensor markets. The company was recognized as one of China's top ten sensor enterprises by Sadie Consulting in 2023. It holds a strong competitive position through superior product performance, quality control systems (IATF16949:2016 certified), and established relationships with major customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2023 revenue of 746.6 million yuan, representing 19.36% growth compared to 625.5 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 79.9 million yuan in 2023 (down 10.55% from 89.3 million yuan in 2022). Total assets reached 2.1 billion yuan at year-end 2023, up 48.68% from 1.41 billion yuan at year-end 2022. The company completed its initial public offering on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange's ChiNext board on December 18, 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through superior product performance in sensitivity, accuracy, and durability; comprehensive quality control systems meeting international automotive standards; rapid product customization and optimization capabilities based on accumulated material formulas and application experience; and integrated vertical supply chain control from material development through manufacturing. The company emphasizes zero-defect quality assurance and provides comprehensive solutions tailored to customer requirements across diverse applications.
